sql: SELECT l.id, l.amount, r.label FROM events_left l JOIN events_right r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id
SELECT l.id, r.amount FROM events_left l LEFT JOIN events_right r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id
SELECT label, SUM(amount) AS total FROM events_left GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS decimal_amount FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CASE WHEN id = 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE amount END AS maybe_amount FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM events_left ORDER BY id
